acceptanceCriteria: AICockpit can create local Tasks, Issues, Sprints, and Epics.
AICockpit can update allowed local work item fields and statuses.
Invalid transitions are rejected through AirframeCore.
Attempts to apply Task or Issue Verified are rejected.
implementationDetails:
Added record-level update support to the Airframe backend protocol and local filesystem backend.
Added AICockpit `create`, `update`, and `status` commands for Tasks and Issues.
Preserved workflow transition checks for status updates and rejected invalid transitions without mutation.
Added explicit human-only rejection for Task and Issue verification commands.
rationale: Agents need local mutation capability that preserves AirframeCore workflow policy and local artifact consistency.

workItem.title: Implement AICockpit local work item mutation support
